taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-08 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 218.1 | 18.02 | 18.02
2 | 105.0 | 1.05 | 19.07
3 | 60.0 | 1.04 | 20.11
4 | 317.3 | 0.57 | 20.68
5 | 1743.2 | 5.17 | 25.85
6 | 2231.3 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-08
Curve type: QHA-type (resistivity falls continuously through Layers 1–3 to a minimum of 60 Ω·m at 20.11 m, then rises continuously through Layers 4–6 to >2200 Ω·m)
Aquifer depth: 18.02 – 20.11 m (the low-resistivity "valley" formed by Layers 2–3, interpreted as a saturated weathered/fractured zone sandwiched between the resistive lateritic overburden above and the increasingly resistive bedrock below)

Recommendation: Plan screen/casing placement across the 18–20 m interval where the conductive weathered zone indicates the main water-bearing horizon; drilling can be stopped once the highly resistive fresh basement (>1700 Ω·m, below ~20.7 m) is confirmed, as this unit is expected to be tight and non-productive.
